# dynamic_function_executions_tool

> View execution history and logs for Dynamic Functions to help with debugging and monitoring.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `dynamic_functions` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=dynamic_function_executions_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

View execution history and logs for Dynamic Functions to help with debugging and monitoring.

This tool retrieves execution records showing when functions ran, their results, errors,
and performance metrics. Essential for debugging function issues and monitoring health.

EXAMPLES:
Recent executions for a function: {function_id: 123, limit: 10}
Get specific execution details: {execution_id: 456}
View failed executions: {failed_only: true}
Filter by trigger: {trigger_type: "schedule"}

RETURNS (compact JSON):
- id: Execution record ID
- function_id/function_name: Which function ran
- trigger_type: How it was triggered
- triggered_by_user_id: User who triggered (if applicable)
- start_at/end_at: Execution timestamps
- execution_time_ms: Duration in milliseconds
- result: Function output (single-execution view only)
- error_message: Error details (for failed executions)

LARGE RESULTS: a tool result is capped at 15,000 characters. A single execution whose result
would not fit is returned PAGED: `result_truncated: true`, `result_total_chars`, `result_page`
(up to 12,000 characters of the result as one compact JSON string), `result_offset`,
`result_next_offset` (null on the last page) and `how_to_continue`. Pass `result_offset` to
fetch the next page; pages are consecutive slices of the same string.
Next page: {execution_id: 456, result_offset: 12000}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `function_id` | integer | no | Filter by function ID. |
| `function_name` | string | no | Filter by function name. |
| `execution_id` | integer | no | Get specific execution by ID. |
| `trigger_type` | string | no | Filter by trigger type: manual, schedule, api, webhook, mcp_tool, nested_call, callback. |
| `success_only` | boolean | no | Only show successful executions. |
| `failed_only` | boolean | no | Only show failed executions. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Number of records (default: 20, max: 100) |
| `result_offset` | integer | no | With execution_id: character offset into the result text to page from (see LARGE RESULTS) |
